what: Vertical work rail. Only the center card is large, at .3 of the page width (3:2 aspect), and its color cycles. The cards above and below are squares at .64 of its size, in grayscale at .7 opacity. Wheel input is gathered into one slot per card height × 1.6, and once it stops for 140ms it settles to the nearest slot (under .12 of a slot it stays put). A drag carries on by release speed × 260px. Motion is a critically damped spring (smoothDamp — wheel .42s · settle .36 + .04 × slot count · drag .16s), so it settles without bouncing. Up/down arrows or clicking another card also advance it, and it loops endlessly.

options.size: Center column width (share of panel width), default .3 — the original is 4 of a 12-column grid
options.small: Rest cell size (share of the center width, square), default .64
options.wheel: Distance per wheel notch (multiple of cell height), default 1.6

note: The original draws with a WebGL plane that bulges toward the center with speed (vertex bend .12) and the area around the cursor swells like a lens, but this part carries over only the lineup, spring and paging rules using DOM cells and CSS grayscale. If you need the bend and lens, use the shader in grayscale-webgl-spring-studio/index.js. The wheel does not scroll the page while over the plane (same as the original) — so use it without covering the full screen height.
